name: video-use
one_liner: Drop your raw video footage in a folder, chat with an AI assistant, and get back a fully edited video — cuts, color grading, and subtitles included.
buyer: A solo content creator or small marketing team that currently spends hours every week manually editing videos and can't afford a full-time editor.
business_use_cases: A solo YouTuber or podcaster turns raw interview footage into a polished, subtitled final cut without touching a timeline editor.
A social media manager batch-processes a week's worth of raw clips into short, subtitled, color-graded posts for Instagram and TikTok.
A course creator turns raw screen-recording and talking-head footage into a finished lesson video automatically.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted 'upload footage, get final.mp4 back' service billed by video minute processed.
Sell it as a monthly editing subscription for creators who post multiple videos a week.

steal_this: Build a simple upload-and-download web wrapper around it this weekend and sell it directly to solo creators as 'your AI video editor' — this is a near-exact fix for a problem creators complain about constantly.
